title: Provide threaded owner chat with any activated agent and safe wake-on-message
description: Owner is monitoring the live Console and wants to talk directly with Session Manager and domain agents. Current durable request composer neither wakes idle recipients nor provides per-agent conversational threads. Build a provider-neutral conversation view over durable TORCH messages, preserving acknowledgements and task references. Clearly distinguish queued, delivered, running, replied and failed/unknown outcomes. Add explicitly reviewed bounded wake-on-message using the qualified executor; coalesce requests, never duplicate an active native session, respect paused fleet and usage limits, and show offline/credit failures honestly. Do not expose prompts, credentials or hidden reasoning. Newly activated domain identities should become selectable without hardcoded roles.
acceptanceCriteria: Owner can open a persistent conversation with Manager or any activated domain and see durable replies after reload
Queued delivery and runtime execution are visibly distinct; sending never implies a reply or completion
Reviewed wakes respect budgets, pause state and existing runtime leases; rapid messages cannot launch duplicate sessions
Provider switch retains TORCH conversation identity and history without reusing foreign native session IDs
Regression scenarios cover idle/offline recipient, paused fleet, multiple messages, launch failure and a newly activated domain
